title: A Passage for the Landfall
author: Emrys Thornbury
blurb: Beatrix Ashgrove, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
